definitions.tier_3_scope: All other locations within the United States and Canada.
definitions.tier_4_scope: International destinations not in Tier 1 or Tier 2 require Finance Operations approval at booking.

faq.scenario: Tier 1 cap exceeded due to citywide event
faq.answer: Employee may book the lowest available rate with manager approval and comparable-rate screenshots; otherwise excess over cap is non-reimbursable.

faq.scenario: Tier 2 premium hotel selected for convenience
faq.answer: Excess over Tier 2 cap is not reimbursable unless lower-cost alternatives were demonstrably unavailable.

faq.scenario: Auto-applied room upgrade with no extra charge
faq.answer: Reimbursable when no additional charge is incurred.
Mandatory cleaning and service fees count toward the nightly cap.
Mandatory resort/gym fees count toward the room cap.

rules.source_quote: Lodging should be booked through the Company's approved booking tool (Concur Travel) whenever practical.
Tier 3 — $175 per night for all other locations in the United States and Canada.
Tier 4 — International destinations not listed above require Finance Operations approval at booking.
Employees should book lodging at least 14 days in advance whenever the trip is planned that far ahead.
Last-minute bookings (under 7 days) require manager approval if the rate exceeds the applicable cap.
Suites, club-level rooms, and view upgrades are not reimbursable unless they are the lowest available rate
Mini-bar, in-room entertainment, spa/recreation surcharges, and personal phone calls are never reimbursable as lodging.
Laundry is reimbursable only for trips exceeding 5 consecutive nights.
Mandatory resort/gym fees count toward the room cap.
Cancellation charges for legitimate business reasons are reimbursable.
No-show or late-cancellation charges due to employee oversight are not reimbursable.
